title: 邮件的结构
goal: 能组织邮件各部分，并写出说明行动与事项的目的句。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 写作

sources.title: ETS：Writing Scoring Guide — Write an Email
sources.used: 0–5 分每一档的描述（本课是中文转述，原文以官方为准）

cards.title: 结构
rows: 称呼
写明收件人。请求放在正文里。
Dear Housing Records Team,
目的句
开头就写明为什么写信、关于什么事。
I am writing to correct the room number on my housing record.
正文：第一条要求
写题目要求的背景，背景要和目的有关。
The record lists Room 18, but my assigned room is Room 81.
正文：第二条要求
接着写相关的信息。不必每条单独成段。
The incorrect number prevents me from receiving building notices.
正文：第三条要求
明确写出要对方做什么。
Could you update the number before the next notice is sent?
结尾
表示感谢，或说明希望得到什么回复。主要事项不留到结尾才提。
Thank you for checking the record.
署名
写信人的名字。
Best regards, Yun Li

cards.title: 常用表达
rows: 询问目的
write to ask about 接所问事项。
I am writing to ask about the insurance form.
请求目的
write to request 接名词，不接完整陈述句。
I am writing to request a replacement membership card.
告知目的
write to report 接具体事件，不只写 this matter。
I am writing to report an error in the equipment inventory.
解释正文
because 后接原因，和主句写在同一句里。
The entry is incorrect because the items were counted twice.
方案正文
suggest 后接动名词或完整从句。
I suggest checking the signed delivery list.
请求正文
Could you 接具体动作，写出动作的对象。
Could you send me a corrected copy?
结束
Thank you for 接名词或动名词。
Thank you for reviewing this correction.

body.box:
Task: Write to the editor of a campus recipe booklet. Identify an omitted ingredient, explain its role, and ask for a correction.

Dear Booklet Editor,
I am writing to report an omission in the lentil soup recipe.
The ingredient list does not include water, although the instructions require it. Without a quantity, readers cannot judge how thick the soup should be. Could you add the required amount to the list before the booklet is printed?
Thank you for reviewing the recipe.
Best regards,
Mei

body.p: I am writing to report an omission 写明了写信的动作和事项。The ingredient list、Without a quantity、Could you add 依次说明遗漏了什么、有什么影响、请求怎样改。前两句是最后请求的依据。

body.box:
Which sentence states the purpose?
1. The writer identifies the kind of correction being reported.
2. The writer thanks the editor for reviewing the recipe.
3. The writer explains how readers judge the soup's thickness.
4. The writer gives the name to appear after the closing.

body.p: 第一项对应 I am writing to report an omission in the lentil soup recipe。其余三项涉及结尾、原因和署名，均不是目的句。

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: 目的只有背景
I enjoy cooking soup.
改为 I am writing to report an omission，写明动作。
请求先于对象
Could you fix it? The recipe lacks water.
先说明 the ingredient list 缺什么，再提出修改的请求。
正文重复目的
I am writing about the recipe. This email concerns the recipe.
第二句改为 The ingredient list does not include water。
结尾加入新事项
Thank you. Also, the booklet price is incorrect.
价格属于题目要求时写在正文里，否则不写。
署名冒充称呼
Dear Mei, … Best regards, Booklet Editor
称呼使用 Booklet Editor，署名使用写信人 Mei。

groups.text:
Task: Write to the registrar to request a copy of a lost enrollment letter.
Draft opening: Dear Registrar, I started my course in September. I have lost my enrollment letter.

items.stem: Which purpose sentence best fits the task?
options: I am writing to request another copy of my enrollment letter.
I am writing to confirm that my course begins in September.
I am writing to report a changed date on my enrollment letter.
I am writing to ask whether I enrolled in the September course.
items.why: request a copy of a lost enrollment letter 要求补发一份入学证明，即第一项。第三项把写信的动作改成了报告日期变更。

groups.text:
Task: Describe a faulty piano pedal, explain its effect, and request inspection.
Draft: Dear Music Room Manager, The pedal does not return after it is pressed. This makes sustained notes difficult to control. Could you inspect the mechanism? Thank you for your help. Best regards, Hugo

items.stem: Where does the draft explain the effect of the problem?
options: In the greeting to the manager
In the sentence about controlling sustained notes
In the request to inspect the mechanism
In the closing expression of thanks
items.why: This makes sustained notes difficult to control 说明了问题的后果，即第二项。它在故障描述之后、检查请求之前。

items.stem: The alumni office needs the purpose of this message.
items.why: I am writing to request 表示目的，to 后面用原形 request。a replacement for 后接要换的东西。

items.stem: The coordinator has agreed to check the meal vouchers.
items.why: Thank you for checking 是感谢句，放在正文之后。for 后面接动名词 checking。

groups.text:
Task: Tell the language-laboratory manager about a damaged headset, describe the affected exercise, and ask for a replacement.

[1] Dear Laboratory Manager,
[2] I am writing to request a replacement for the headset at Station 8.
[3] The left speaker has no sound, so I cannot compare the two recordings in today's exercise.
[4] Could a working headset be placed there before the next session?
[5] Thank you for your assistance.
[6] Best regards,
Amir

items.stem: Which pair gives the purpose first and then develops its background?
options: Sections 1 and 5
Sections 4 and 6
Sections 2 and 3
Sections 5 and 6
items.why: 第 2 部分 request a replacement 提出目的，第 3 部分 left speaker has no sound 说明原因，即第三项。

items.stem: What makes section 2 a clear purpose sentence?
options: It explains every step of the listening exercise.
It names the writer after the closing.
It thanks the manager before making a request.
It names the desired action and the affected equipment.
items.why: request a replacement 写明行动，the headset at Station 8 写明对象，即第四项。背景放在后面的句子里。

groups.text:
Task: Write to the manager of a campus bicycle locker service. Identify a damaged locker latch, explain why it prevents secure storage, and request a repair.

[1] Dear Locker Manager,
[2] I am writing to request a repair to Locker 12.
[3] The latch is bent and will not hold the door shut.
[4] Since the door remains open, I cannot leave my bicycle safely inside.
[5] Could you arrange a repair before my next class on Thursday?
[6] Thank you for considering this request.
Best regards,
Jia

options: It states the action sought and the locker concerned.
It gives the exact time of the writer's next class.
It explains the physical cause of the damaged latch.
It acknowledges a repair that has already been completed.
items.why: request a repair to Locker 12 写明了要做的事和哪个储物柜，即第一项。维修还没有做，第四项不对。

items.stem: Why does section 4 belong between sections 3 and 5?
options: It replaces the request with an expression of thanks.
It connects the defect with the reason for requesting action.
It introduces a new locker unrelated to the damaged latch.
It confirms that Thursday's class caused the bent latch.
items.why: Since the door remains open 接着第 3 部分的故障，cannot leave my bicycle safely 说明了要求维修的理由，即第二项。

groups.text:
Task: Ask the campus radio archivist for permission to reuse an interview recording, explain its intended use, and give credit to its creators.

Dear Radio Archivist,
I am writing about an interview in the archive. Our history society plans to play a short extract during an oral-history display. The speakers' names and the station's name will appear beside the recording. Could you authorize this use?
Thank you for considering the request.
Best regards,
Rosa

items.stem: Which replacement makes the opening's purpose explicit?
options: I am writing to identify the speakers already named beside the recording.
I am writing to describe the station that created the archive.
I am writing to seek permission to use part of an archived interview.
I am writing to confirm that the interview has already been authorized.
items.why: 后文 Could you authorize this use? 说明写信是为了申请使用许可，即第三项。第四项写成已获许可，与原文不符。

items.stem: Which sequence describes the body after the opening?
options: Credit, permission request, intended use
Permission request, credit, intended use
Intended use, permission request, credit
Intended use, credit, permission request
items.why: plans to play 说明用途，names will appear 说明署名，Could you authorize 提出请求，顺序与第四项一致。

items.stem: The course office needs a statement of why the reading list is being requested.
items.why: I am writing to ask for 表示索取资料的目的，to 后面用原形 ask。

items.stem: A message to the athletics secretary reports an incorrect team name.
items.lead: The purpose of this email is
items.why: is to report 表示目的，to 后面用原形 report。an error in 引出出错的名单。

items.stem: The guest speaker is being thanked at the end of a message.
items.why: Thank you for considering our invitation 是完整的结尾句，for 后面用动名词 considering。

items.stem: The writer closes a message after requesting an updated duty roster.
items.why: look forward to 是固定搭配，这里的 to 是介词，后面接 receiving。这句适合放在请求之后作结尾。
